title: Estilo indirecto (he said that…)
goal: Al terminar podrás contar lo que otra persona dijo, preguntó, pidió o prometió (he said that…, she asked if…, they told us to…), ajustar tiempos, pronombres y expresiones de tiempo sin errores, y redactar el resumen de una reunión o un acta para alguien que no estuvo.

lesson.title: Introducción
lesson.html:
El estilo directo repite las palabras exactas, entre comillas: Mark said, "The crane is broken." El estilo indirecto cuenta el mensaje con tus palabras, sin comillas: Mark said (that) the crane was broken.

En el trabajo lo usas todo el tiempo: cuando le cuentas a tu jefe lo que dijo el cliente, cuando resumes una reunión para alguien que no fue, cuando escribes un acta (minutes) o cuando explicas por qué se cambió un plan (the inspector told us to stop). Un error aquí cambia el mensaje: he said he will vs he said he would no es solo gramática; marca si la promesa sigue vigente.

lesson.title: El "paso atrás" de los tiempos (backshift)
lesson.html:
Si el verbo que introduce la frase está en pasado (said, told, asked), lo que se dijo normalmente da un paso atrás en el tiempo. La lógica es simple: hablas desde el presente sobre palabras que ya quedaron en el pasado.

DirectoIndirecto (said / told…)En español
"The pump is noisy."He said the pump was noisy.Dijo que la bomba hacía ruido.
"We're welding the nozzle."They said they were welding the nozzle.Dijeron que estaban soldando la boquilla.
"I checked the bolts."She said she had checked the bolts.Dijo que había revisado los pernos.
"The client has approved it."He said the client had approved it.Dijo que el cliente lo había aprobado.
"I'll send the report."Ana said she would send the report.Ana dijo que enviaría el informe.
"We can start on Monday."They said they could start on Monday.Dijeron que podían empezar el lunes.
"You must wear a harness."He said we had to wear a harness.Dijo que teníamos que usar arnés.
"The test may take two days."She said the test might take two days.Dijo que la prueba podría tardar dos días.

lesson.title: Reglas de oro
lesson.html:
Regla de oro 1 — Verbo introductor en pasado = un paso atrás

Con said, told, explained, mentioned: is → was, will → would, can → could, pasado / presente perfecto → had + participio.

He said he would call. Nunca He said he will called.

Regla de oro 2 — SAY algo; TELL a alguien

Say no lleva persona directamente: She said (that)… / She said to me… (poco común). Tell siempre lleva persona: She told me (that)…

He told us the test was OK. Nunca He said us… ni He told that…

Regla de oro 3 — Pregunta indirecta = orden de afirmación

Al reportar una pregunta, el sujeto vuelve antes del verbo y desaparecen do/does/did y el signo de interrogación. Si no hay palabra WH-, se usa if o whether.

"Where is the inspector?" → He asked where the inspector was. Nunca He asked where was the inspector.

"Did you check the torque?" → She asked if I had checked the torque.

lesson.title: Cuándo NO hace falta dar el paso atrás
lesson.html:
CasoEjemploPor qué
El verbo introductor está en presenteMark says the crane is broken.Lo dice ahora (o acaba de escribirlo): no hay distancia.
Sigue siendo verdad hoyShe said she works in Houston.Aún trabaja ahí. She said she worked… también es correcto.
Verdad general o dato técnicoHe said carbon steel rusts in seawater.Es un hecho permanente.
Algo futuro que aún no pasaThe client said he will visit next week.La visita sigue pendiente; would también es correcto.
Modales sin pasadoHe said we should check it.Should, would, could, might no cambian.

Así piensa un nativo — el backshift marca distancia

Un nativo no aplica la tabla como una máquina. Elige según cómo ve el mensaje hoy. He said the valve is leaking = sigue fugando, hay que actuar. He said the valve was leaking = lo reporto como dato del momento en que lo dijo, sin afirmar que sigue igual.

En actas y reportes formales, lo más seguro es siempre dar el paso atrás. En conversación, si es actual, mantener el presente suena natural y más urgente.

lesson.title: Pronombres, tiempo y lugar
lesson.html:
Cambian porque cambia quién habla, cuándo y dónde. Cambia solo lo que la lógica exija: si lo cuentas el mismo día, today sigue siendo today.

DirectoIndirecto (otro día / otro lugar)Ejemplo
today / tonightthat day / that nightHe said he was busy that day.
yesterdaythe day before / the previous dayShe said the parts had arrived the day before.
tomorrowthe next day / the following dayThey said they would finish the next day.
next weekthe following weekHe said the crane would come the following week.
last monththe month before / the previous monthShe said the tank had been inspected the previous month.
… ago… before / … earlierHe said he had joined two years before.
nowthen / at that momentShe said she was in a meeting at that moment.
here / this / thesethere / that / thoseHe said those pipes were damaged.

lesson.title: Traducción directa vs interpretación real
lesson.html:
El español hace casi lo mismo (dijo que estaba, dijo que vendría), así que tu instinto ayuda. Los problemas vienen de decir (que en inglés se divide en say y tell), del subjuntivo en órdenes (me dijo que esperara) y del orden en las preguntas.

Lo que piensas en españolLo que dice un nativo
Me dijo que estaba cansado.He told me he was tired.
Me dijo que esperara.He told me to wait.
Me preguntó dónde vivía.She asked me where I lived.
Me preguntó si tenía auto.She asked me if I had a car.
Nos pidió que no fumáramos.He asked us not to smoke.
Dijo que vendría mañana.He said he would come the next day.
EspañolTraducción literal (mal)Inglés real
Me dijo que estaba cansado.He said me that he was tired.He told me (that) he was tired.
Me dijo que esperara.He said me that I wait.He told me to wait.
Me preguntó dónde vivía.She asked me where did I live.She asked me where I lived.
Me preguntó si tenía auto.She asked me do I have a car.She asked me if I had a car.
Nos pidió que no fumáramos.He asked us that we don't smoke.He asked us not to smoke.
Le pregunté qué hora era.I asked him what time was it.I asked him what time it was.

lesson.title: Afirmaciones, preguntas, órdenes y respuestas
lesson.html:
Cada tipo de frase tiene su propia estructura en estilo indirecto. Esta tabla cubre afirmativo, negativo, pregunta (sí/no y WH-) y la respuesta corta.

TipoEstructuraDirecto → Indirecto
Afirmativosaid (that) / told + persona (that) + oración"It's ready." → He said it was ready.
Negativoigual, con el negativo desplazado"I don't know." → She said she didn't know.
Pregunta sí/noasked (+ persona) + if / whether + sujeto + verbo"Is it safe?" → He asked if it was safe.
Pregunta WH-asked (+ persona) + WH- + sujeto + verbo"When did it fail?" → She asked when it had failed.
Respuesta cortasaid (that) + sujeto + auxiliar (desplazado)"Yes, I can." → He said he could.
Orden / pedidotold / asked + persona + (not) to + verbo"Don't touch the valve." → He told us not to touch the valve.

lesson.title: Detalles que marcan la diferencia
lesson.html:
• That es opcional después de say y tell: He said (that) he was late. En textos formales se suele escribir.
  • Whether = if, un poco más formal; es obligatorio antes de or not al inicio: She asked whether or not the test had passed.
  • No uses comillas ni signo de pregunta en la pregunta indirecta: He asked what I wanted.
  • Las preguntas indirectas también sirven para preguntar con cortesía (sin pasado): Could you tell me where the site office is? · Do you know if the crane has arrived?

lesson.title: Verbos para reportar: más precisos que SAY
lesson.html:
Elegir el verbo correcto vale más que repetir said. Cada grupo tiene su propia estructura:

¿Qué hizo la persona?VerbosEstructura
Informó algosaid / told me, explained, confirmed, mentioned+ (that) + oración
Preguntóasked, wanted to know, wondered+ if / WH- + sujeto + verbo
Pidió u ordenótold us, asked us, reminded us, warned us+ (not) to + verbo
Se comprometiópromised, agreed, offered, refused+ to + verbo

dialog.text: Edwin, I couldn't join the client meeting this morning. How did it go?
It went well overall. Sarah said they were happy with the bottom repair.
Good. Did she ask about the delay?
Yes. She asked why the hydrotest had been postponed. I explained that the water quality report hadn't arrived yet.
She told me she would call the lab herself. She also asked us not to fill the tank before she approved the report.
She wanted to know if we could send the inspection photos by Friday. I promised to send them tomorrow.
Perfect. Did anyone mention the extra cost for the nozzle?
Mark brought it up. Sarah said she needed to discuss it with her manager and would reply next week.
OK. Please put all that in the minutes and copy me.

examples.en: The inspector said that two welds had failed the X-ray test.
examples.es: El inspector dijo que dos soldaduras habían fallado la radiografía.

examples.en: The safety officer told us not to enter the tank without a gas test.
examples.es: El oficial de seguridad nos dijo que no entráramos al tanque sin prueba de gases.

examples.en: The client asked if we could finish the hydrotest by Friday.
examples.es: El cliente preguntó si podíamos terminar la prueba hidrostática para el viernes.

examples.en: The supplier promised that the flanges would arrive the following week.
examples.es: El proveedor prometió que las bridas llegarían la semana siguiente.

examples.en: Mr. Lee wanted to know why the crane hadn't arrived.
examples.es: Mr. Lee quería saber por qué no había llegado la grúa.

examples.en: Ana told me she was working on the new isometrics.
examples.es: Ana me dijo que estaba trabajando en los nuevos isométricos.

examples.en: The engineer explained that the supports had been moved 50 mm.
examples.es: El ingeniero explicó que los soportes se habían movido 50 mm.

examples.en: The doctor told me to drink more water and rest for two days.
examples.es: El médico me dijo que tomara más agua y descansara dos días.

examples.en: The bank officer asked me where I worked and how much I earned.
examples.es: El empleado del banco me preguntó dónde trabajaba y cuánto ganaba.

examples.en: The airline said our flight had been canceled because of the storm.
examples.es: La aerolínea dijo que nuestro vuelo había sido cancelado por la tormenta.

examples.en: The waiter asked us whether we wanted a table inside or outside.
examples.es: El mesero nos preguntó si queríamos una mesa adentro o afuera.

examples.en: Carlos said he couldn't come to the party because he was on the night shift.
examples.es: Carlos dijo que no podía venir a la fiesta porque estaba en turno de noche.

examples.en: They agreed to reduce the price if we signed before the end of the month.
examples.es: Aceptaron bajar el precio si firmábamos antes de fin de mes.

examples.en: Sarah reminded me to send the daily report before 5 p.m.
examples.es: Sarah me recordó que enviara el reporte diario antes de las 5 p. m.

examples.en: The contractor confirmed that all bolts had been torqued to the specified value.
examples.es: El contratista confirmó que todos los pernos habían sido ajustados al torque especificado.

errors.wrong: He said me that he was tired.
errors.right: He told me (that) he was tired.
errors.why: Con persona se usa tell; say no lleva persona directa.

errors.wrong: She told that the test was OK.
errors.right: She said that the test was OK.
errors.why: Tell necesita persona. Sin persona → say.

errors.wrong: He asked where was the inspector.
errors.right: He asked where the inspector was.
errors.why: Pregunta indirecta = orden de afirmación (sujeto + verbo).

errors.wrong: She asked me where did I work.
errors.right: She asked me where I worked.
errors.why: Did desaparece; el verbo lleva el pasado.

errors.wrong: He asked me do I have a car.
errors.right: He asked me if I had a car.
errors.why: Pregunta sí/no → if / whether + orden normal.

errors.wrong: He told me that I wait.
errors.why: Órdenes y pedidos = told / asked + persona + to.

errors.wrong: She told us don't touch it.
errors.right: She told us not to touch it.

errors.wrong: He said he will called me.
errors.right: He said he would call me.
errors.why: Will → would + verbo base; nunca base + -ed.

errors.wrong: She said she has finished yesterday.
errors.right: She said she had finished the day before.
errors.why: Pasado → had + participio; yesterday se desplaza si lo cuentas otro día.

errors.wrong: He asked: "if the crane had arrived?"
errors.right: He asked if the crane had arrived.
errors.why: El estilo indirecto no usa comillas ni signo de pregunta.

falseFriends.fix: He intended to… / He tried to…
She let me know / informed me…
He argued with me. / We discussed the cost.

A1.prompt: Mark dijo que la grúa estaba malograda.
answers: Mark said that the crane was broken.
Mark said the crane was broken.
A1.explain: Sin persona → said. Is → was. "Malograda" = broken.

A1.prompt: El inspector me dijo que la soldadura estaba bien.
answers: The inspector told me that the weld was OK.
The inspector told me the weld was OK.
The inspector told me that the weld was fine.
The inspector told me the weld was fine.
The inspector told me that the weld was okay.
The inspector told me the weld was okay.
A1.explain: Con persona (me) → told. Nunca said me.

A1.prompt: Ana dijo que enviaría los planos al día siguiente.
answers: Ana said that she would send the drawings the next day.
Ana said she would send the drawings the next day.
Ana said that she would send the drawings the following day.
Ana said she would send the drawings the following day.
A1.explain: Will → would; "al día siguiente" = the next / following day.

A1.prompt: El cliente preguntó si podíamos empezar el lunes.
answers: The client asked if we could start on Monday.
The client asked whether we could start on Monday.
A1.explain: Pregunta sí/no → if; can → could; orden we could.

answers: He asked me where I worked.
She asked me where I worked.
He asked me where I was working.
She asked me where I was working.
A1.explain: Pregunta WH-: where + I + worked, sin did.

A1.prompt: El supervisor nos dijo que usáramos arnés.
answers: The supervisor told us to wear a harness.
A1.explain: Orden → told + us + to + verbo. El subjuntivo "usáramos" = to wear.

A1.prompt: Nos pidió que no fumáramos cerca del tanque.
answers: He asked us not to smoke near the tank.
She asked us not to smoke near the tank.
A1.explain: Pedido negativo → asked + us + not to.

A1.prompt: Dijeron que ya habían terminado la prueba.
answers: They said that they had already finished the test.
They said they had already finished the test.
A1.explain: "Habían terminado" = had finished; already entre had y el participio.

A1.prompt: Ella quería saber cuánto costaba la reparación.
answers: She wanted to know how much the repair cost.
A1.explain: WH- + sujeto (the repair) + verbo (cost, pasado igual que presente). Nunca how much did the repair cost.

A1.prompt: El proveedor prometió entregar las bridas la semana siguiente.
answers: The supplier promised to deliver the flanges the following week.
The supplier promised to deliver the flanges the next week.
A1.explain: Promise + to + verbo; "la semana siguiente" = the following / next week.

A2.prompt: He told me he had been working there for five years.
answers: Me dijo que llevaba cinco años trabajando allí.
Me dijo que había estado trabajando allí cinco años.
Me dijo que había estado trabajando allí durante cinco años.
A2.explain: Had been working = presente perfecto continuo desplazado (Módulo 14).

A2.prompt: She asked whether the report had been approved.
answers: Ella preguntó si el informe había sido aprobado.
Ella preguntó si se había aprobado el informe.
Preguntó si el informe había sido aprobado.
A2.explain: Whether = si; pasiva en pasado perfecto (Módulo 20).

A2.prompt: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.
answers: El médico me aconsejó descansar una semana.
El médico me aconsejó que descansara una semana.
El doctor me aconsejó descansar durante una semana.

A2.prompt: They said they couldn't come because of the storm.
answers: Dijeron que no podían venir por la tormenta.
Dijeron que no podían venir debido a la tormenta.
Dijeron que no podían venir a causa de la tormenta.

A2.prompt: Mr. Lee reminded us to sign the permit before starting.
answers: Mr. Lee nos recordó firmar el permiso antes de empezar.
Mr. Lee nos recordó que firmáramos el permiso antes de empezar.
El señor Lee nos recordó firmar el permiso antes de comenzar.
A2.explain: Remind + persona + to = recordarle a alguien que haga algo.

B.prompt: He said me that the pump was broken.
answers: He told me that the pump was broken.
B.explain: Con persona → told, no said me.

B.prompt: She told that the drawings were ready.
answers: She said that the drawings were ready.
She told us that the drawings were ready.
B.explain: Sin persona → said. (También: She told us that…)

B.prompt: The client asked when would we finish the job.
answers: The client asked when we would finish the job.

B.prompt: He asked me where did I buy the gaskets.
answers: He asked me where I had bought the gaskets.
He asked me where I bought the gaskets.
B.explain: Sin did; pasado desplazado → had bought. (where I bought también se acepta.)

B.prompt: She asked me do I need help.
answers: She asked me if I needed help.

B.prompt: The supervisor told us to starting at 7.
answers: The supervisor told us to start at 7.
B.explain: Orden → told us to + verbo base; después de to no va -ing.

B.prompt: He told us don't weld in the rain.
answers: He told us not to weld in the rain.

B.prompt: Ana said she will sent the report the next day.
answers: Ana said she would send the report the next day.

B.prompt: He asked if the test has passed the day before.
answers: He asked if the test had passed the day before.
B.explain: Con the day before y asked: had passed.

B.prompt: She reminded me sign the permit.
answers: She reminded me to sign the permit.

bonus.prompt: Reporta en estilo indirecto: Sarah: "Will the tank be ready tomorrow?" (lo cuentas una semana después).
bonus.answer: Sarah asked if / whether the tank would be ready the next day. (Will → would; tomorrow → the next day porque lo cuentas una semana después.)

C1.instructions: Completa el resumen con estas palabras; usa cada una una sola vez: said, told, asked, if, to, not, would, had.

lines.text: So, what happened at the site meeting?
The client [1] that she was worried about the schedule.
She [2] why the hydrotest [3] been postponed. She also wanted to know [4] we could work on Saturday.
I [5] her that we could. I promised that the test [6] be done by Monday.
Yes. She asked us [7] send her the water report, and she told us [8] to fill the tank without her approval.

answers: said
blanks.explain: Sin persona después: The client said that…

answers: asked
blanks.explain: Introduce una pregunta WH-: She asked why…

answers: had
blanks.explain: Pasado perfecto pasivo: the hydrotest had been postponed.

answers: if
blanks.explain: Pregunta sí/no reportada: wanted to know if we could…

answers: told
blanks.explain: Con persona (her): I told her that…

answers: would
to
not
blanks.explain: Orden negativa: told us not to fill.

C2.prompt: Redacta el resumen de una reunión (7 puntos). Escribe un correo de 6 a 8 oraciones a un colega que no pudo asistir a una reunión (real o inventada). Debe incluir: (a) una afirmación reportada con said o told y paso atrás del tiempo; (b) una pregunta sí/no reportada con if / whether; (c) una pregunta WH- reportada con orden correcto; (d) una orden o pedido con told / asked + persona + (not) to; (e) un compromiso con promised / agreed / offered to; (f) al menos una expresión de tiempo desplazada o bien justificada; (g) saludo, asunto y cierre profesionales.
rubric: (a) una afirmación reportada con said o told y paso atrás del tiempo
(b) una pregunta sí/no reportada con if / whether
(c) una pregunta WH- reportada con orden correcto
(d) una orden o pedido con told / asked + persona + (not) to
(e) un compromiso con promised / agreed / offered to
(f) al menos una expresión de tiempo desplazada o bien justificada
C2.model:
Subject: Summary – Tank 12 client meeting (Oct 14)
Hi Carlos,
Here is a quick summary of yesterday's meeting with Sarah. She said the bottom repair looked very good, but she was worried about the schedule. She asked if we could work on Saturday. She also wanted to know why the hydrotest had been postponed, and I explained that the water report hadn't arrived. She asked us not to fill the tank before she approved the report. Mark offered to bring a second crew, and Sarah agreed to discuss the extra cost with her manager the following week. Let me know if you have any questions.
Best regards,
Edwin

cando.test: Completa 10 frases con said / told en 1 minuto; 10 de 10 correctas.

cando.skill: Aplicar el paso atrás de los tiempos.
cando.test: Pasa a indirecto 8 frases (is, are working, did, has done, will, can, must, may) en 3 minutos, cero errores.

cando.skill: Reportar preguntas con el orden correcto.
cando.test: Reporta 6 preguntas (3 sí/no, 3 WH-) sin usar do/did ni invertir el sujeto.
Escribe 5 frases con told / asked / warned / reminded + persona + (not) to; 5 de 5 correctas.

cando.skill: Ajustar expresiones de tiempo y lugar.
cando.test: Di en 30 segundos el equivalente indirecto de: today, yesterday, tomorrow, next week, ago, now, here.

cando.skill: Contar una reunión de forma oral.
cando.test: Grábate 60 segundos resumiendo una reunión real con al menos 5 verbos introductores distintos.
